html:
I built a Grok bot that answers the 'what's for dinner' question for me. It plans the week around what's on sale and builds the grocery list, so I'm not standing in Publix at 5 PM with no plan. Here's the template if you want your own: https://t.co/KgS44PCUls

— Ashley Schendel (@ashleyschendel) October 14, 2026
